name: Cartdini – Checkout Field Editor for WooCommerce
author: Plugins.shop

sections.description:
Add custom WooCommerce checkout fields without code. Collect gift messages, delivery instructions and purchase references; keep customers’ answers with the order.

Nine Free field types work in Classic Checkout and Checkout Blocks. No Cartdini account, license or subscription.

Custom checkout fields included in Free

  • Nine types: text, textarea, dropdown select, checkbox, radio buttons, email, telephone, number and URL.
  • Up to 100 questions: Order information, Contact or shared billing/shipping addresses.
  • Field controls: labels, help, supported placeholders, optional/required answers and supported text/number limits.
  • Editor: reorder, duplicate, disable and structurally preview questions; save explicitly.
  • Saved answers: select display on supported admin/customer order pages and emails.
  • Storage: High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS) and legacy orders.

Practical questions for your store

  • Add a gift message textarea for the packing team.
  • Collect delivery instructions or an additional contact number alongside an address.
  • Collect a purchase order number as text; this does not create purchase orders or change payment methods.
  • Offer a dropdown or radio question for an order preference, without adding a charge.

Address questions share billing/shipping definitions. Virtual orders preserve saved shipping answers instead of replacing them with billing answers.

Manage existing checkout fields

Checkout manager controls differ by checkout:

  • Classic: supported labels, placeholders and positions; six optional-field visibility/requirement controls and individual resets.
  • Blocks: shared Company, Phone and Address line 2 visibility/requirements, supported address labels/order and default Place Order text. Shared settings can affect Classic; explicit Classic overrides win. Native settings save separately.

Essential address/email validation and country requirements stay with WooCommerce. Blocks contact email, address placeholders and sections remain native; gateways may override button text. Cartdini does not remove every required field.

For shared native address settings, Hidden on checkout hides the input. Saved address data and values submitted through WooCommerce’s API may still be stored, including on the shopper’s order and saved customer addresses. This is a visibility control, not a rule that rejects or erases native address data. Cartdini custom questions use separate controls.

Setup guides | Compatibility and limitations | Support

Optional Cartdini Pro add-on

Separate paid Cartdini Pro adds conditional fields, fixed paid extras for eligible choices, private uploads, date availability rules, time/multiple-choice inputs, repeatable groups, reusable setups and order-answer CSV tools. Uploads/groups are order-only.

Pro functionality is implemented in the separate, optional add-on, not unlocked inside Free. The active add-on requires an initial license activation for its editing/tools. Disconnecting its license leaves its saved checkout behavior running; deactivating the add-on pauses Pro-only behavior. Free retains saved Pro settings and protects their rule sources against incompatible edits to prevent data loss. Other Free fields remain editable without a license. Pro is not auto-installed. Previews never publish fields, upload files or charge shoppers.

Related WooCommerce plugins from Plugins.shop

Optional tools from our team for your WooCommerce store:

  • Frictions – WooCommerce checkout session replay — investigate eligible checkout visits and observed errors with protected structural replay.
  • OrderFloor – WooCommerce minimum order and quantity limits — set minimum order amounts, quantity limits and pack multiples.
  • OrderWorth – WooCommerce cost of goods and profit reports — review product costs, expenses and estimated profit for WooCommerce orders.

None is required or auto-installed. Check their requirements; links do not imply automatic integration or guaranteed compatibility.

Privacy and local preferences

Answers stay in your WordPress/WooCommerce database. Free sends no answers or administrator preferences to Cartdini. Request necessary information only and explain purpose, recipients and retention in your privacy policy. Suggested wording: Settings > Privacy.

  • Browser storage: drafts hold field settings, not shopper/preview answers, files or credentials. Full-screen/contextual dismissals use browser storage; WordPress navigation is visible by default.
  • Pro previews: On/Off persists per administrator/store across browsers/updates. It controls optional previews/suggestions, not real Pro workflows; Explore Pro stays available. Remembered tasks require an explicit remember/pricing action, use local administrator metadata and expire after seven days.
  • Local action counts: off by default. When enabled, preview opens, pricing clicks and matching workflow saves are counted for 90 days, not purchases/conversion rates. No shopper answers/license keys; disabling clears counts. Expired tasks/counts use WordPress cron and support privacy export/erasure. Previewing is not consent to measurement.
  • Review invitation: only in Cartdini settings after 30 days and qualifying checkout use on three dates; disabled on development/local/staging sites. Eligibility stores a first-use time and at most three dates, no order IDs/customer details/answers. Local per-administrator/store review/dismissal preferences persist across updates and support export/erasure. Remind in 30 days or stop permanently; no payment verification, review-submission tracking or external analytics.

The optional More Plugins screen bundles artwork/descriptions; opening it sends no request and installs nothing. Product links open Plugins.shop. Free makes no external service requests; following documentation/support/pricing links opens that website. Pro license connections are separately disclosed and require explicit administrator action.

Source and licenses

Readable PHP/JavaScript/CSS need no build. Dependencies/translations: assets/SOURCE.md. Local fonts make no requests; SIL license: assets/fonts/OFL.txt. Plugin license: GPLv2 or later, LICENSE.txt.
sections.installation:
Requires WordPress 6.7+, PHP 8.0+, WooCommerce 9.9+ and JavaScript for the editor.

  1. Activate WooCommerce, then install Cartdini through Plugins > Add New or upload the Free ZIP.
  2. Activate Cartdini. Ordinary single activation opens the editor; otherwise open WooCommerce > Cartdini.
  3. Add a question, review its type/location and choose Save questions & fields.
  4. Test checkout, missing/invalid answers and saved order/email answers before going live.

Fresh installs enable no sample questions. Save applies changes; reactivation resumes saved settings.

Back up; replace without uninstalling. Keep Free active and update it before Pro. The matched releases are Free 1.8.11 and Pro 1.8.11; existing Pro 1.8.7 remains compatible (minimum Free 1.8.4). Settings/history are retained. Update pre-1.8.0 pairs together; incompatible Pro features pause. Recovery details: administration-notes.txt.
sections.faq:
Can I add a gift note or delivery instructions for free?

Yes: add a textarea, label it and choose its location. Conditional display requires Pro. Gift notes are separate from WooCommerce’s native “Add a note to your order” option; label them distinctly.

Does it work with the block checkout?

Yes: all nine Free types support both. Existing-field controls differ as described above. Test your theme/gateways; not every third-party checkout builder is supported.

Why does my custom field appear after payment?

Order questions follow the Order information block in your Checkout page. Move that block before Payment in the page editor if preferred. Question-reorder arrows do not move sections. The structural preview is not your exact storefront layout.

Where are checkout answers saved?

With orders and, for supported contact/address fields, customer accounts. Order-only notes are not account-prefilled. Display settings control supported order/email output; hiding answers does not delete them. CSV export and optional Orders-list answer columns require Pro.

What if I leave before saving?

Drafts last up to 24 hours in the same browser tab for your administrator/store. Closing it or clearing storage may remove them. Recovery requires review and Save. Follow retry/reload guidance after conflicts; custom questions and native Blocks settings save separately.

What happens if I remove a field or delete Cartdini?

Removing a field keeps historical answers. Deactivation/deletion retains settings, recovery data and saved answers. With Free and WooCommerce active, WordPress privacy tools export account/order answers; erasure removes account answers and follows WooCommerce order-retention settings. Keep compatible Pro active to erase private uploads; no license is needed for erasure. Failed/unreadable storage remains retryable, preserving order identity/answers until private-file erasure is checked safely. Removing both plugins leaves retained data outside their privacy tools.
sections.changelog:
1.8.11

  • Improve PHP formatting and developer documentation without changing checkout, storage or concurrent-edit protection.
  • Explain why saved Pro-dependent fields remain protected when the separate add-on is missing or editing is unavailable; independent Free fields remain editable.
  • Align current upgrade guidance with the separate Pro 1.8.11 release; existing Pro 1.8.7 remains compatible.

1.8.10

  • Clarify shared native address controls with “Hidden on checkout” and accessible help explaining that WooCommerce may still store saved or API-submitted address values.
  • Preserve checkout validation, address-saving behavior, customer profiles and order history; no new storage restriction is introduced.

1.8.9

  • Preserve editor save bodies in browser-based WordPress Playground using WordPress REST method override. Keep both revision checks and the save lock.
  • Report missing or invalid save requests separately from genuine concurrent-edit conflicts.

1.8.8

  • Preserve saved shipping answers on virtual Checkout Blocks orders; retain normal physical-order copying.
  • Exclude nonapplicable shipping answers from order details and emails.
  • Harden customer identity checks and remove obsolete answers from reused checkout drafts, preserving history.
  • Make busy or failed preference erasure retryable.
  • Remain compatible with Pro 1.8.7; no Pro update required.

Full release notes and earlier versions: changelog.txt.
